record.label: Lambda-cubed shell native pilot
record.summary: The lambda-cubed Edgeworth shell arm is terminal with a dual verdict. Host side: the shell genuinely improves the Q24 host - protected-40 raw host MSE 8.030968799749751e-8 versus 8.919980524938374e-8, a 9.967% reduction, the campaign's first real host-accuracy improvement, with the weight algebra machine-certified against an independent polynomial construction and every rollout finite at about 2.0e12 FLOPs funded by the conditional repair. System side: the refit-J corrected pilot is 3.136551362360925e-8 versus the baseline 3.107235383605394e-8, a 0.943% regression - J corrected 65.17% of the base host's error but only 60.94% of the smaller X residual, so the shell removes precisely the systematic fourth-order component the observer could already reconstruct. The corrected system sits at an invariant near 3.1e-8 (native pilot frame; 3.23e-8 development frame) now measured from BOTH directions: five observer arms on the fixed host and three host arms under the frozen observer form. This is the joint information floor of the current architecture.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed measured under its frozen scaling gate; no channel variant, no retune. The dual verdict stands as the program's measured position: raw 1e-8 requires a structurally different system, not another lever inside this one; the banked W2 conditional-repair card remains the best board candidate.
